test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: According to the passage, what is one drawback of System 1 thinking?

options.text: It always leads to incorrect decisions.
It requires too much mental effort.
It can be prone to biases and snap judgments.
It completely replaces System 2 in decision-making.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• System 1 is described as quick and intuitive, but it is also **prone to biases and snap judgments**.
 
• It does not always lead to wrong decisions, but its reliance on instinct can sometimes reduce rational accuracy.
 
• This drawback is important because it shows why System 2 must occasionally step in with deliberate reasoning.
 
• Thus, the correct drawback is that System 1 **can be biased and impulsive**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: “It always leads to incorrect decisions”** – Incorrect, because the passage clearly says System 1 is often accurate.
 
• **Option 2: “It requires too much mental effort”** – Incorrect, System 1 works automatically with **little or no effort**.
 
• **Option 4: “It completely replaces System 2”** – Incorrect, the passage shows that both systems share a division of labour.
